# technitium_api_token (Resource)

Creates a non-expiring Technitium API token for a user, for use by automation. The token value is only returned at creation time and is stored in Terraform state — treat the state accordingly.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `token_name` (String) Name for the token, unique per user.
- `user` (String) The username to create the token for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in the form user/token_name.
- `partial_token` (String) The partial token identifier used by the sessions API.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API token value.
